🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; confirmations: universal sector weakness (all 11 sectors 1W negative) and mixed news flow (76 bullish vs 41 bearish) with narrow leadership. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Technology & Consumer Discretionary).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology contains the bulk of weekly winners: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +0.63%). Consumer Discretionary shows isolated strength: RCL RECOVERY (1W: +15.44% | 1M: -0.48%), BKNG RECOVERY (1W: +4.50% | 1M: -17.98%). Energy has selective winners: VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +7.99%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples lagging with WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -5.98% | 1M: -0.91%) and EL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -9.32%). Materials weak: NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.31%). Industrials under pressure: BA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -10.46%) and HD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.12% | 1M: -12.58%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Top 5: RCL RECOVERY (1W: +15.44% | 1M: -0.48%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%), BKNG RECOVERY (1W: +4.50% | 1M: -17.98%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +0.63%). 5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: GM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -10.61%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -3.57%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -10.46%), F BELOW TREND (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -13.49%), QCOM TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -6.69% | 1M: +8.54%). Weakness concentrated in autos and select cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: RCL (1W: +15.44%), AMAT (1W: +7.80%), LRCX (1W: +6.91%), BKNG (1W: +4.50%). Major divergence present — multiple large-cap names show 1W vs 1M mismatches (AAPL TREND EXHAUSTION, META TREND EXHAUSTION, QCOM TREND EXHAUSTION) — treat outperformance as tactical, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: several equipment and semicap names ABOVE TREND (AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%), TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +7.35%)) while mega-cap FAANGs show exhaustion (AAPL TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +5.10%), META TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -2.54% | 1M: +26.80%)). Sector 1W: -0.25% | 24 stocks — internal dispersion, watch equipment vs platform divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft across majors: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -7.08%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -5.28%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -6.42%). Sector 1W: -1.67% | 20 stocks — breadth weak, financials not providing cyclical leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive tone but limited strength: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +0.03%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +0.21%), AMGN RECOVERY (1W: +3.80% | 1M: -1.95%). Sector 1W: -0.15% | 17 stocks — selective pockets of accumulation.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to semicap and hardware winners (AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%), TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +7.35%)) and maintain positions in select energy/refining names (VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +7.99%)); reduce exposure to broad Financials and defensives showing consistent 1W weakness (JPM BELOW TREND, WMT BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +1.11%) — watch follow-through. BEARISH: IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -5.96%), SLB BELOW TREND (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -18.51%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -3.57%) — monitor for accelerating breakdowns.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Select Technology equipment (semicap) given AMAT/LRCX strength despite sector weak 1W. BEARISH: Consumer Staples and Materials — continued weekly weakness and notable large-cap declines. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive remains the dominant macro signal.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
AMAT: sustain weekly gains/close above the recent 1W high to confirm continuation of ABOVE TREND. MSFT: hold above short-term trend to confirm above-trend regime. SLB/TSLA: close below the recent monthly lows would signal deeper BELOW TREND momentum and increased downside risk. Watch AAPL and META for failure to retake 1W gains as a trigger for broader risk-off flows.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (+60): Microsoft headline and strong quarter align with price action — MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +1.11%) — sentiment largely confirming price. ACN (+85): strong bullish headline but not in provided price detail here — monitor price for confirmation. (Note: limited dual-timeframe data provided for some news names; prioritize MSFT where price confirms sentiment.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-45): headline on tax/accounting scrutiny aligns with short-term pullback — META TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -2.54% | 1M: +26.80%) — divergence between strong 1M gains and recent distribution. ASML (-45): negative headlines on adoption timelines conflict with price — ASML ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +6.82%) — this is a divergence to watch for distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +11.56%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +9.08%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +1.11%) showing relative strength. Key risk: Breadth 0/11 sectors positive and major divergences in AAPL, META and QCOM — monitor for trend breaks and news-driven distribution.
